scripts.test: npm run test:matching && npm run test:fixtures
scripts.test:fixtures: python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory . >/tmp/autoapply-fixture-server.log 2>&1 & server=$!; trap 'kill $server' EXIT; sleep 1; python3 tests/fixture_browser.py
scripts.test:extension: npm run build && (python3 -m http.server 8765 --directory . >/tmp/autoapply-fixture-server.log 2>&1 & server=$!; trap 'kill $server' EXIT; sleep 1; python3 tests/extension_browser.py)
